basis.en: First published in 1867; the text used is from 1891–92; the author died in 1892.
basis.zh: 1867 年初刊，所用文本为 1891–92 年版；作者卒于 1892 年。

note.en: A short poem from Leaves of Grass: a page of doubts, then an answer two lines long. The answer does not argue the doubts away; it changes the question from what life is worth to what one might add to it. “You may contribute a verse” is a quiet invitation, and this library takes it literally.
note.zh: 出自《草叶集》的一首短诗：一页的疑问，然后是两行的回答。回答并没有把疑问驳倒，而是把问题从“生命值多少”换成了“你能为它添上什么”。“你可以献上一句诗”是一个安静的邀请，这座图书馆照字面接受了它。

excerpt.orig:
That you are here—that life exists and identity,
That the powerful play goes on, and you may contribute a verse.
excerpt.en:
That you are here—that life exists and identity,
That the powerful play goes on, and you may contribute a verse.
excerpt.zh:
你在这里——生命存在，自我存在，
那场宏大的戏仍在上演，而你可以献上一句诗。

note.en: Seven lines of doubts and a two-line answer that has become a motto; the answer is good, but the complaints before it are Whitman at his most diffuse.
note.zh: 七行疑问，两行回答，回答成了座右铭；答得好，但前面的抱怨是惠特曼最散漫的写法。
